propositions: Four graph functions exhibit high cyclomatic complexity (16-22) driven by duplicated reduce-all-filter-index loops and hand-rolled BFS patterns across call sites.
The identical reduce_all_tickets+drop-error+index-by-id pattern is duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, violating DRY.
BFS traversal logic for cycle detection and blocked-by discovery is reimplemented separately in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level, duplicating queue/visited bookkeeping.
Extracting shared helpers (load_indexed_states, accumulator bfs) into _loader.py and _relations.py reduces CCN to ≤7 while preserving behavior and node-set.
All four targeted functions must pass existing test suites unchanged and fall below cyclomatic complexity threshold of 15.
A new characterization test must pin the accumulator-vs-visited distinction: _get_all_blocked_by includes blocks targets with no backing ticket dir and excludes the seed id.
